raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`use_strided_prefill_z` is gated on `_is_cuda`, so ROCm materialises `mixed_qkv`/`z`/`b`/`a` through `fused_qkvzba_split_reshape_cat_contiguous` where CUDA takes free strided views via `qwen3_5_gdn_prefill_projection_views`.

That helper contains no kernel and nothing device-specific — it is plain slicing and `.view()`. The consumers are already stride-aware:

- the gated RMSNorm Triton kernel takes explicit `stride_z_row` / `stride_z_token` / `stride_z_head`;
- `mixed_qkv` is only read by `causal_conv1d_fn`, whose output is a fresh tensor;
- the post-conv split `fused_qkv_split_gdn_prefill` already admits `is_hip()`.

## Modifications

```diff
             use_strided_prefill_z = (
-                _is_cuda and forward_batch.forward_mode.is_extend_without_speculative()
-            )
+                _is_cuda or _is_hip
+            ) and forward_batch.forward_mode.is_extend_without_speculative()
```

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K, full 1319-question test set, `--thinking-mode qwen-3`, temperature 0, 2 runs per arm (2638 samples each), on 8x MI355X:

| arm | score |
|---|---:|
| stock | 0.9708 |
| #41677 (decode fused proj+conv) | 0.9666 |
| #41683 (prefill strided z) | 0.9663 |
| both | 0.9723 |

No significant difference against stock (two-proportion z-test: p = 0.38 / 0.34 / 0.74). Spread across arms is 0.61 pp against a 0.48 pp binomial standard error for a single run, and the both-patches arm scores highest — inconsistent with any additive degradation.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

8x MI355X (gfx950), TP=8, `amd/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B-Quark-MXFP4` (ships as `Qwen3_5MoeForCausalLM`; 69 of 92 layers are GDN), SGLang `v0.5.20-rocm10-mi35x`, prefill-isolated 8192/1 @ concurrency 8, 4 runs per arm:

| metric | stock | patched | delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| prefill throughput (tok/s) | 24000.7 | 24256.7 | **+1.07%** |
| mean TTFT (ms) | 2614.5 | 2586.8 | −1.06% |

Kernels on the GDN prefill path (torch profiler, TP-0), per prefill step:

| kernel | stock | patched |
|---|---:|---:|
| `fused_qkvzba_split_reshape_cat_contiguous_kernel` | 69.1 | **0** |
| `_causal_conv1d_fwd_kernel` | 69.1 | 69.0 |
| `chunk_fwd_kernel_o` | 69.1 | 69.0 |

The contiguous-materialisation kernel is eliminated; the GDN work kernels are unchanged.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests — covered by the existing `test/registered/attention/test_gdn_prefill_layout.py`, which exercises `qwen3_5_gdn_prefill_projection_views` directly; can extend its CI registration to a ROCm runner if preferred.
- [ ] Update documentation — no user-facing change.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results.
- [x] Follow the SGLang [code style guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

nodes.body:
Thanks for the PR! I have a minor comment above and also we should add tests as checklist suggests: "Add unit tests — covered by the existing test/registered/attention/test_gdn_prefill_layout.py, which exercises qwen3_5_gdn_prefill_projection_views directly; can extend its CI registration to a ROCm runner if preferred."

Otherwise LGTM!

Useful PR!
Indeed, theoretically everything should work smoothly, as the triton consumers must be stride-aware as the cuda ones,  but we do need a practical rocm-test for the feature (+++ @omirosh ).  

Unfortunately I have not had a chance yet to run a comparative benchmark on mi355 due to the lack of compute.

I will come to conclusion once the test is on its place and "green"

Both done.
On the test: registered `test_gdn_prefill_layout.py` on `stage-b-test-1-gpu-large-amd`, same as `test_gdn_noncontiguous_stride.py` sitting next to it. Nothing else needed changing — the file already uses `device="cuda"` and has a `__main__` entry, and despite the name the flashinfer-prepare test is pure Triton, no flashinfer import.

@amd-oshkarav I ran it on 8x MI355X (gfx950) here — 4 passed:

```
t.py::TestGdnPrefillLayout::test_fused_split_flashinfer_prepare_reuses_contiguous_value PASSED
t.py::TestGdnPrefillLayout::test_projection_views_preserve_layout PASSED
t.py::TestGdnPrefillLayout::test_qkv_prepare_preserves_dtype_and_matches_materialized_path PASSED
t.py::TestGdnPrefillLayout::test_strided_gate_matches_contiguous_gate PASSED
```

Perf on the same box, prefill-isolated 8192/1 @ concurrency 8: 24,000.7 -> 24,256.7 tok/s (+1.07%), mean TTFT -1.06%.

<!-- pr-check-comment runs=39252941421 -->
Required checks failed on c635970; this PR cannot be merged until they pass.

**Lint** ([run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39252941421))
Run `pre-commit run --all-files` locally and push the result. The run log shows any other failing step.

After this PR, the fused kernel runs on AMD only for non-extend batches, right? Extend batches use the strided views, the same as on CUDA. Please add one sentence, for example: "Plain extend batches skip it on both CUDA and HIP and use qwen3_5_gdn_prefill_projection_views."
Yep — plain extend takes the strided views on both now, so the fused kernel only sees decode and spec-extend. Added that to the comment above the ratios tuple in 49822d9.

files.patch:
@@ -193,7 +193,8 @@
 # plus the `torch.cat` of the unfused fallback. On CUDA the ratio-3 dense 27B
 # layout is handled by the Triton kernel's per-head walk (the CPU fused op
 # still requires a power-of-two group). Other backends keep the original
-# tuple so their control flow is unchanged.
+# tuple so their control flow is unchanged. Plain extend batches skip the fused
+# kernel on both CUDA and HIP and use qwen3_5_gdn_prefill_projection_views.
 _GDN_FUSED_QKVZBA_RATIOS = (
     (1, 2, 4, 8) if _use_aiter else (1, 2, 3, 4) if _is_cuda else (1, 2, 4)
 )
@@ -1032,9 +1033,8 @@ def forward(
             # The strided views feed only prefill GDN; DP-relabeled decode rows
             # run the decode kernels, so pick the layout from the logical mode.
             use_strided_prefill_z = (
-                _is_cuda
-                and forward_batch.logical_forward_mode.is_extend_without_speculative()
-            )
+                _is_cuda or _is_hip
+            ) and forward_batch.logical_forward_mode.is_extend_without_speculative()
             split_fn = (
                 qwen3_5_gdn_prefill_projection_views
                 if use_strided_prefill_z

@@ -15,9 +15,10 @@
 from sglang.srt.layers.attention.linear.gdn_backend import GDNAttnBackend
 from sglang.srt.layers.attention.mamba.mamba2_metadata import ForwardMetadata
 from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
-from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci, register_cuda_ci
 
 register_cuda_ci(est_time=6, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+register_amd_ci(est_time=6, stage="stage-b", runner_config="1-gpu-large-amd")
 
 
 @unittest.skipIf(not torch.cuda.is_available(), "Test requires CUDA")
